newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan business head says rate review likely - Jiji.
newsitem.headline: Japan business head says rate review likely - Jiji.

text.p: A review of Japan's monetary policy may get under way from the summer, a key business leader was quoted as saying on Thursday by Jiji news agency.
"It is about time that discussions (over the review of monetary policy) started," Jiro Ushio, chairman of the Japan Association of Corporate Executives, was quoted as saying by Jiji.

"Discussions may get under way from the summer towards the end of the year taking into account the business conditions at smaller firms, the bad loan issue at financial institutions, and the management of financial institutions ahead of the 'Big Bang' (financial reforms)," Ushio was quoted as saying.
